hypothesis: A single state-conditioned selection among retained fixed reference laws can improve the complete seen Stand5 mission over the eligible fixed alpha0.25 while choosing that same fixed law at seen Stand10.

rule.proxy: Original local x=8, y=8*tan(alpha*wrapped heading difference), transformed from actual entry to world
rule.screen: cos(delta)>0 and nominal-line lateral/heading within unchanged original strict limits; no empirical safety margin
rule.objective: Minimum predicted current waypoint Euclidean error among compatible nominal lines
rule.tie: Lower alpha on exact equal predicted error
rule.invalid: Reject nonfinite input; unresolved if no candidate; do not claim physical stop
rule.persistence: Choose alpha once at first Walk entry and use the same alpha at every remaining Walk with original per-node frame semantics
rule.limitation: Nominal reference-line compatibility is neither necessary nor sufficient for actual dynamic strict/physical success

offline_checks: real same-alpha historical outcomes kept separate
discard_rule_if: both retained entries select same alpha
rule reads outcome or case identifier

proposed_acquisition.source_and_execution_gate: Separate runner/source/assets/dependency freeze, nonphysical tests and Owner authorization required before acquisition; this rule package has no physics runner
proposed_acquisition.replay_gate: Before second arm, the first arm must reproduce retained same-alpha original scientific outcomes and all available comparable state/command samples under a pre-frozen comparison contract; inability to establish compatibility stops both-arm study
proposed_acquisition.pairing: Identical original Stand5 construction and complete predecision observable states, controller/policy reset semantics and source; no injected simulator state, no reset after entry
proposed_acquisition.residual: off for all arms and all nodes
proposed_acquisition.no_extra_control: Stand10 selection .25 matches historical whole-mission .25 by construction. Reuse as historical support, not a new adaptive run or independent sample. Alpha0 only historical context.
proposed_acquisition.stop: Any technical/integrity/reset/budget mismatch or physical failure stops campaign; retain established failure and missing coverage separately. No retry or severity/alpha scan. Strict failure preserves complete evidence only while original physical gates permit execution; never force blocked nodes.

prospective_comparison.numerical_tolerance_role: Arithmetic comparison only, not physical safety or historical success tolerance
prospective_comparison.candidate_support: Both complete arms retain original all-node strict and physical; selected arm improves final world endpoint norm by at least 0.01m, with no worse designated ordered waypoint position norms or final absolute world X/Y/heading beyond numerical tolerance
prospective_comparison.minimum_effect_role: Prospective minimum useful endpoint improvement for this comparison, fixed before new data; not a change to any original success label and not statistical significance
prospective_comparison.tradeoff: Any local/physical regression or adverse retained route/X/Y/heading component prevents joint support; preserve continuous benefits and costs separately
prospective_comparison.no_advantage: Fixed .25 equally good or better, or improvement below 0.01m: do not retain extra adaptive mechanism
prospective_comparison.inconclusive: Missing compatibility, replay, paired-state or outcome evidence; never infer a new result by splicing different controllers
prospective_comparison.scope: Seen-condition development contrast within declared discrete candidate set, not best continuous alpha, generalized adaptation or production safety
